content:
Apple is set to unveil a range of new products this fall, including a new iPhone, Mac, iPad and more. Here's everything rumored to debut starting September 9.

iPhone: new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, and an iPhone Ultra

Apple's flagship iPhone 18 lineup is going ultra-premium this fall, with reports suggesting the base iPhone 18 has been cancelled and won't arrive until early 2027.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: major camera upgrades, a unique new color, smaller Dynamic Island and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: the biggest battery ever, possibly exclusive camera features
  • iPhone Ultra: Apple's first foldable iPhone

Wearables: AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Apple Watch Series 12

Apple is reportedly planning to unveil three new wearables at its September event: the AirPods 5, and updates to two of its flagship Apple Watch models.

  • AirPods 5: refreshed base and ANC models
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: new health sensors, design updates and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: upgraded S-series chip, new health features

Mac: MacBook Ultra, new M6 MacBook Pro and more

Apple has already released several new Macs this year, but three more models are reportedly on the way, expected to arrive in October.

  • MacBook Ultra: a new high-end model with OLED display, touch support and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: entry-level MacBook Pro updated with M6 chip
  • M6 iMac: refreshed color options

iPad: OLED iPad mini and possibly a new base iPad

A new iPad Air already launched earlier this year, but two more iPads could arrive before the end of 2026: an iPad mini with OLED and a new base iPad.

  • New iPad mini: OLED display and upgraded chip
  • Base iPad: A18 chip to power Apple Intelligence

Apple home products: Apple TV 4K, HomePad and more

Apple is keen to expand its home product lineup, but has reportedly been waiting on its Siri AI features. Here's what's in the pipeline.

  • New Apple TV 4K: upgraded A-series chip, Apple Intelligence, new Siri Remote
  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: new home hub with 7-inch touchscreen display and magnetic base
  • HomePod 3: upgraded full-size HomePod with new chip to power Apple Intelligence
  • HomePod mini 2: new chip, audio improvements and more
  • Apple Security Camera: first-party smart home accessory with HomeKit Secure Video

Apple is also reportedly working on a video doorbell with Face ID, though there have been no updates on that in some time.

Which new Apple product coming this fall are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
